label: Roles
createSuccess: Role created. Assign it to an API key or user to put it to work.

rolesOverview.heading: Roles Overview
rolesOverview.description: Roles provide a way to grant or deny API access to specific services or apps.
rolesOverview.nameHint: Name the role for what it grants, like read-only or billing-admin. You will attach it to API keys and users.

accessOverview.heading: Access Overview
accessOverview.description: This section allows you set up rules for a role restricting what services and components users assigned to the role will have access to. Advanced Filters are for implementing additional server side filter logic on database transactions.
accessOverview.tableDescription: Access rules for DreamFactory services. Use caution when allowing system access.

lookupKeys.heading: Lookup Keys Overview
lookupKeys.description: The DreamFactory administrator can create any number of 'key, value' pairs attached to a role. The key values are automatically substituted on the server. For example, key names can be used in the username and password fields required to hook up a SQL or NoSQL database. They can also be used in Email Templates or as parameters for external REST services. Any Lookup Key can be marked as private, and in this case the key value is securely ncrypted on the server and is no longer accessible through the platform interface. Lookup keys for service configuration and credentials must be made private.

roleScope.heading: Access scope for role "{{name}}"
roleScope.noAccess: This role grants no service access.
roleScope.footer: This role can ONLY access the services and components listed under "Allowed" above. All other data is invisible to anything operating under this role, including AI.
